restrictions: One batch of ceil(9943*2^128/10000) iid uniform 36-byte messages (BE32(u)||BE4(w)); repeated inputs are retained and rejected as collisions; no restart.
Complete standard-IV target hash with the official prefix round window, padding, mode and all 256 output bits; one selected target compression/permutation per trial.
Classical 256-bit word RAM; exact two-level sparse direct-address dictionary, correct for arbitrary initial contents; every reserved cell included in memory.
Worst-case 104 ordinary operations per trial, plus 2^20 setup and 2^14 final verification/output operations; every ordinary operation uses the official selected-target weight.
Generic fixed-function probability proof; no random-oracle, output-balance, differential, extrapolation or PRNG independence premise.
Analytic infeasible-memory construction, not a measured full-scale attack. Native code and wrapper/table operation envelopes remain review obligations.
